verdict.rationale: Twenty explicitly documents export of workspace data for backups/migration with 'no lock-in', supports CSV/XLSX export/import, self-hosting via Docker, and open REST/GraphQL APIs for full data access, giving AI-native users a clear path to extract data in open formats and leave. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of export completeness/fidelity and no mention of export format limits beyond CSV (e.g., no JSON/SQL dump documented) or corroboration outside vendor docs.
